Discover an exceptional opportunity to secure 13.775 acres of prime land in the highly sought-after Mulgoa region, perfectly positioned on the doorstep of Western Sydney's future growth corridor.
Located just minutes from the Western Sydney Aerotropolis, Science Park precinct, and the new Badgerys Creek International Airport, this expansive holding offers outstanding long-term potential while remaining conveniently close to Penrith CBD and major transport links.
Surrounded by picturesque natural beauty, the property enjoys a peaceful rural setting with easy access to the Blue Mountains, the Nepean River, and surrounding parklandscreating an ideal balance between privacy, lifestyle, and connectivity.
Whether envisioned as a private retreat, lifestyle acreage, or a strategic landholding for the future, this versatile parcel presents a rare chance to secure substantial land in an increasingly valuable location.
Opportunities of this scale and position are becoming increasingly scarce. Enquire now to explore the full potential of this remarkable Mulgoa acreage.

To enquire, please email or call 1300 815 051 and enter code 2017
